message.content: {"caption":"Twelve line charts compare accuracy across math, code, and aggregate benchmarks as the horizontal value increases from 50 to 250.","description":"A 3-by-4 grid of line charts. Each horizontal axis is marked from 50 to 250, and the vertical axis is Accuracy; the vertical scales differ among plots. Blue lines show the math benchmarks and Math Average, orange lines show the code benchmarks and Code Average, and the green line shows Overall Average. The top two rows are headed MATH REASONING and contain AIME 2024, AIME 2025, Olympiad Bench, Minerva, Math 500, and AMC 2023. AIME 2024 varies sharply, with a high near 0.20 at x≈200; AIME 2025 also fluctuates, reaching about 0.13 near x≈130 and x≈260, with several values near zero. Olympiad Bench rises from about 0.29 to the mid-0.30s, fluctuates mostly around 0.36–0.40, and ends near 0.37. Minerva fluctuates, peaking near 0.385 around x≈130 and ending near 0.31. Math 500 rises from about 0.625 to around 0.74, peaks near 0.75 around x≈210, then declines to about 0.705. AMC 2023 is volatile, peaks near 0.625 around x≈170, then falls to about 0.375 near x≈250 before a small recovery. The orange CODE REASONING row contains HumanEval+, MBPP+, and LiveCodeBench. HumanEval+ generally fluctuates around 0.71–0.73 and ends around 0.73; MBPP+ rises to about 0.695 near x≈120, then trends down to about 0.667; LiveCodeBench generally rises from around 0.24 to a peak near 0.287 around x≈180, then fluctuates and ends around 0.265. The green OVERALL PERFORMANCE row contains Math Average, Code Average, and Overall Average. Math Average is variable, peaking near 0.393 around x≈130 and ending near 0.34. Code Average remains comparatively steady, mostly around 0.545–0.561. Overall Average rises from about 0.423 to a local high around 0.474 near x≈130, then fluctuates mostly in the mid-0.40s. A red star marks that high point on the Overall Average curve. No arrows or check/cross marks are shown.
